name: Serpent Strike
description: A low, flicking jab that seeks a meridian gap. The qi that rides the blow is faintly green and hungry.

name: Five Poisons Palm
description: The signature art of the Five Poisons Sect. Five venoms — viper, centipede, toad, spider, scorpion — ride a single palm strike. The target's qi meets five small wars at once.

name: Centipede Stance
description: A low stance that mimics the rippling footwork of the centipede. The body becomes plates; a blow that lands draws blood from the striker in return.

name: Web of Silk
description: A spidering lattice of qi cast across the opponent's senses. For a breath, they cannot tell left from right, nor heart from hand.

name: Bleeding Pincers
description: The scissoring bite of great pincers; the wound it leaves does not easily close.

name: Toad's Breath
description: A puffing cloud of sickly yellow vapor. Crude — but effective.
